table.name: TLGNC_LOADINGPOINT
table.description: Loadingpoints (German: Ladestrasse) belong to a shippingpoint. Loadingpoints differ in their packaging type (bag, bulk) and availability of weighing systems etc. The Loadingpoint is located at the shippingpoint and is used for loading; whereas the silo is located at the shipto and used for unloading.

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. The shippingpoint to which the loadingpoint belongs to.

column.name: LOADINGPOINT_NAME
column.description: Name of the loadingpoint, used to display it in Logon. Must be unique per Shippingpoint.

column.name: LOADINGPOINT_OBJECT_LABEL
column.description: The identifying name of this loadingpoint at the shippingpoint. Often the same as loadingpoint_name, but can be changed to some catchy, short identifier which is printed on a plate at the loadingpoint. This field, together with plant_cd and sap_shippingpoint_no, is used to form the rfidobject.object_label (search string when rfid tag is missing). Must be unique per Shippingpoint.

column.name: PACKAGE_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_package_type. Defines which packaging type (Bag, Bulk) can be loaded at this loadingpoint. Logon only distinguishes the major types, whereas SAP distinguishes 'Silo (Silosteller)', 'Pallet (empty)', 'Service' in addition. Logon does not 'load' services, and empty pallets are just treated as an aspect of Bag, Silosteller as an aspect of Bulk.

column.name: WEIGH_SYSTEM_LP_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_weigh_system_lp_bs. The weighing system type which is in use at this loadingpoint. 0=LDS from shipping point, 2=Manual LOGON, 3=Manual PDA.

column.name: DELIV_NOTE_PRINT_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_deliv_note_print_type_bs. In case a delivery note has to printed, field defines which system is responsible for it: LOGON, Parallel, SAP/others.

column.name: DELIV_NOTE_COPIES_LOGON
column.description: Number of copies to print when a delivery note with logon type is printed.

column.name: WEIGH_SYSTEM_LOADINGPOINT_NO
column.description: The identifier of the loadingpoint known to the weighing system within the scope of a shippingpoint or plant. For Parallel (Truck and Rail) this is the 'Verladestrassenummer' a 2 digit number which defines the Parallel Terminal, connected to the server specified in tlgnc_shippingpoint.parallel_spid. For WeWaS: Something similar, 1-2 digit number, unique per plant.

column.name: PRINTER_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_printer_bs. The printer used at the loadingpoint, for example to print delivery notes.

column.name: PLANT_TRACK_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_track_bs. For Rail only: The track of this loadingpoint. tlgnr_plant_track_bs.plant_cd must be equal to the plant of the shippingpoint of this loadingpoint.

column.name: WAGON_LOAD_FIRST_POSITION_FLAG
column.description: If this flag is set to 1, the wagon loaded at this loading point will be inserted at the first position on the track, else they will be inserted at the last position

column.name: LEAVE_LP_DELAY_MIN
column.description: Average delay in minutes for a loading point (LDS) to trigger the endLoad event. Is used to calculate the biz_leave_sp_ts (reporting) on order finalization in case no PDA event is available.

column.name: LOADING_TIME
column.description: Loading time in minutes. If null, the loadingtime is not defined for this loadingpoint and the application default value is used (see tlgnr_config, app.default.loadingpoint.LoadingTime_min).

column.name: GROSS_WEIGHT_LIMIT_KG
column.description: Gross (Brutto) Weight limit in kg. Max gross sent to parallel = min (max gross truck/trailer and loading point).

column.name: RFIDOBJECT_ID
column.description: The ID which is used to associate this object (loading point) with RFID tags. An RFID object can have several RFID tags.
